query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS "count: _"
            FROM
                message m
            INNER JOIN
                chat c
            ON
                c.chat_id = m.chat_id
            WHERE
                m.chat_id = ?1
                AND m.sender_user_uuid IS NULL
                AND m.status != ?2
                AND m.timestamp > c.last_read
                AND c.is_incoming
                AND NOT c.is_confirmed_connection
                AND c.status = ?3
